answer: The hoop cutter shears his iron bands to length, and the shear must cut square or the joint will not close. Cooper beech barrel scraper fir warrant is the shearing: a warrant beech barrel scrapers show after scraping bench trials. The umber is the first shear, cut at the bench; the walnut is the last, cut before the bands are bent, and the inlet is the bench itself, scarred by a thousand cuts. A forger would need 71 false shears and 71 false benches.
